name: Memory %
programText:
a = data('container_memory_working_set_bytes', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'controlcenter-0')).sum()
b = data('kube_pod_container_resource_limits', filter=filter('namespace', 'confluent') and filter('pod', 'controlcenter-0') and filter('resource', 'memory') and filter('container', 'controlcenter')).sum()
(a/b*100).publish(label='Memory %')
